kpi-value.purpose: One per tile; the largest type on screen.

page-title.purpose: The single h1 in the sticky header.

column-header.purpose: Table th and kanban column headings; uppercase, muted.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: Ambient: panels, standalone KPI tiles, kanban cards. Paired with inset 0 1px 0 var(--edge) on panels and tiles.

shadows.name: edge
shadows.purpose: Top-edge catch-light, applied as inset 0 1px 0 on layered surfaces.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: 160ms state transitions on nav, buttons, inputs.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: og-settle 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) backwards; stagger 30ms per child, max 150ms
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: sections settle in on first paint (opacity 0->1, translateY 6px->0). Dialog reuses it at 160ms both.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation/transition durations under prefers-reduced-motion; og.js also sets chart animation=false.

glow.purpose: Accent mix for the two body::before radial gradients.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default action; panel-2 fill with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font:500 13px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding:7px 14px; min-height:34px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); background:var(--panel-2,#191d25); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted,#98a1b3) 45%, var(--border,#262b36)); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2,#191d25) 80%, var(--text,#e8ebf1) 4%); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring,#7cc4ff); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid accent; the one blue action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font:600 13px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding:7px 14px; min-height:34px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--accent,#7cc4ff); background:var(--accent,#7cc4ff); color:var(--accent-ink,#0a0c10); cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#7cc4ff) 90%, transparent); transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#7cc4ff) 88%, white); border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#7cc4ff) 88%, white); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring,#7cc4ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Outlined critical; confirm step of a destructive action.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font:600 13px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding:7px 14px; min-height:34px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 60%, var(--border,#262b36)); background:transparent; color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 10%, transparent); border-color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring,#7cc4ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Safe-stop Button
components.description: Scoped safe-stop control; must stay visually distinct and hard to hit by accident.
components.css: .ds-btn-safestop { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; font:700 13px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:9px 18px; min-height:34px; border-radius:8px; border:2px solid var(--status-critical,#ee6160); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 12%, var(--panel,#12151b)); color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-btn-safestop:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 18%, var(--panel,#12151b)); } .ds-btn-safestop:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring,#7cc4ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Stacked label above a panel-2 field; accent border and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:6px; font:500 12px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); } .ds-input { width:100%; font:400 14px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); background:var(--panel-2,#191d25); border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); border-radius:8px; padding:7px 11px; min-height:36px; transition:border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted,#98a1b3) 80%, transparent); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted,#98a1b3) 45%, var(--border,#262b36)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--accent,#7cc4ff); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#7cc4ff) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Top-level content surface with title and muted intro.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--panel,#12151b); border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); border-radius:12px; padding:20px 22px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 16px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.8), inset 0 1px 0 var(--edge,rgba(255,255,255,.045)); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); font:400 14px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { font-size:15px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; margin:0 0 14px; } .ds-panel > p:first-of-type { color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); font-size:13px; margin:-8px 0 16px; } .ds-panel dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:max-content 1fr; gap:8px 20px; margin:0; font-size:13px; } .ds-panel dt { color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); } .ds-panel dd { margin:0; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: KPI Tile
components.description: Label, tabular value with unit, stale badge; severity colours the value only.
components.html:
Fleet SoC
62.4%
age: 95s
components.css: .ds-kpi { background:var(--panel,#12151b); border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); border-radius:12px; padding:16px 18px 14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4), 0 16px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.8), inset 0 1px 0 var(--edge,rgba(255,255,255,.045)); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); font-family:Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); } .ds-kpi-value { font-size:26px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.1; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:6px; } .ds-kpi-unit { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); } .ds-kpi[data-severity=critical] .ds-kpi-value { color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); } .ds-kpi[data-severity=caution] .ds-kpi-value { color:var(--status-caution,#eda100); } .ds-kpi[data-severity=good] .ds-kpi-value { color:var(--status-good,#1baf7a); } .ds-stale { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; margin-top:auto; } .ds-stale::before { content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--status-good,#1baf7a); } .ds-stale[data-stale=true] { color:var(--status-caution,#eda100); font-weight:600; } .ds-stale[data-stale=true]::before { background:var(--status-caution,#eda100); } .ds-stale[data-stale=true]::after { content:'\00b7\00a0stale'; font-weight:500; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Colour + dot + drawn icon + text; never colour alone.
components.html: online stale fault
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:2px 8px 2px 7px; border-radius:999px; font:600 11px/18px Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; border:1px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; } .ds-icon { width:12px; height:12px; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:2.5; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-badge-good { color:var(--status-good,#1baf7a); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-good,#1baf7a) 12%, transparent); } .ds-badge-caution { color:var(--status-caution,#eda100); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-caution,#eda100) 12%, transparent); } .ds-badge-critical { color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 12%, transparent); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Rail item: muted at rest, panel-2 on hover, 14% accent tint when active.
components.html: Control roomFleet
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; width:212px; padding:6px; background:var(--panel,#12151b); border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); border-radius:12px; font:500 14px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:8px; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-nav-icon { width:18px; height:18px; flex:none; stroke:currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; opacity:.85; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--panel-2,#191d25); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); } .ds-nav-item.active { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent,#7cc4ff) 14%, transparent); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-item.active .ds-nav-icon { color:var(--accent,#7cc4ff); opacity:1; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring,#7cc4ff); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Confirm Dialog
components.description: Step 2 of every grid-changing action: title, summary, countdown, Cancel + danger/safe-stop Confirm.
components.html:
Confirm setpoint

bank-01 to 5.0 kW. This is step 2 of 2.

Expires in 42s
components.css: .ds-dialog { background:var(--panel,#12151b); border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); border-radius:16px; padding:24px 26px 22px; max-width:460px; box-shadow:0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.6), 0 32px 80px -32px rgba(0,0,0,.9); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); font:400 14px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:16px; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.01em; } .ds-dialog > p { margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--muted,#98a1b3); font-size:13px; } .ds-countdown { color:var(--text,#e8ebf1) !important; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-dialog-actions { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; margin-top:20px; } .ds-btn, .ds-btn-danger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:500 13px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding:7px 14px; min-height:34px; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn { border:1px solid var(--border,#262b36); background:var(--panel-2,#191d25); color:var(--text,#e8ebf1); } .ds-btn-danger { font-weight:600; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 60%, var(--border,#262b36)); background:transparent; color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--status-critical,#ee6160) 10%, transparent); border-color:var(--status-critical,#ee6160); }

narrative.overview: A control room that stays quiet until something needs attention. Layered near-black surfaces, one cool blue for everything interactive, fixed severity and chart palettes, tabular numerals, Lucide outlines at 1.5 stroke, roomy Operate-mode density, one settle-in moment. Dark is default; light mirrors every token.
keyCharacteristics: Status is colour + icon + text, never colour alone
Tonal layering plus hairline and catch-light; shadows are ambient only
All text tokens >= 4.5:1 on bg, panel, panel-2 in both themes (enforced by tests-e2e/ui/test_a11y.py)

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: If it is blue and not a status badge or the first chart series, it is interactive.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: A state is colour + dot + drawn icon + text.

rules.name: The Same-Roles Rule
rules.body: Light theme changes values, never roles; add a colour to both blocks or neither.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything that can hold a number sets tabular-nums and right-aligns in tables.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Structural Rule
rules.body: Uppercase only for column headers, kanban headings, badges, safe-stop. No eyebrows or kickers.

rules.name: The Twenty Rule
rules.body: Sections 20px apart, panels padded 20px; tighter is inside a component, looser is a page margin.

rules.name: The Nested-Goes-Flat Rule
rules.body: A KPI tile inside a panel drops shadow and border and sits on panel-2.

rules.name: The Soft-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are large-blur, negative-spread, black-alpha; the only coloured shadow is the accent lift.

dos: Do take every colour from a token (var(--x) in CSS, token:--x@alpha in chart options).
Do add new text tokens to both themes at >= 4.5:1 on bg, panel, panel-2.
Do keep --kicker a literal hex equal to --accent in both themes.
Do keep severity and the seven series tokens at their spec values and order.
Do render state with status_badge.html and attach stale_badge.html to displayed values.
Do route grid-changing operator actions through the two-step confirm dialog.
donts: Don't restyle .btn-safestop toward the primary or danger variants.
Don't use accent on static text or decoration.
Don't add uppercase intro lines or eyebrows above headings.
Don't add motion beyond the settle-in and 160ms transitions; never bypass prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't add hard-offset or coloured shadows, icon fonts, glyph icons, or a second icon stroke weight.
Don't let a grid child set its own min-width or overflow.
